svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 10/12 The Bike Trails (Common)
svg.desc: Trails slip under the big roads, so you can ride a long way before you ever wait for a light. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
